reviews.text: We left our dog for 2 weeks with Rohit. He took excellent care of her and sent us photos every day! It was great to enjoy our trip knowing she was safe and being well-cared for.

Rohit is absolutely the best. I was nervous dropping my dog off, but he came back tired both days! Rohit took the time to walk him and play with him. Above all that, he sent photos every few hours to show me how Loki was doing. Cannot recommend Rohit enough. 💜🐶
We had an amazing experience with Montreal Dog Club. Our pup got his own luxury vacation while we were exploring the city. So many fun pictures, videos and constant updates! Thank you so much.

We are very satisfied with how everything was handled. Our dog enjoyed a wonderful time and was treated with the utmost care and affection. It’s clear that the staff truly loves animals, and that passion reflects in how happy our pup is.
Took great care of our dog Sammy. This was our dog's first dog boarding. Lily was very patient and loving. We highly recommend Montreal Dog Club! Thank you!

I'm so happy and satisfied with the amazing care for our dog. We recently moved to Montreal and it has been difficult for our dog.

We have used their services 4 times so far and each one has been perfect!
We couldn’t have asked for a better environment for our pup. Such a cozy and calm apartment. Perfect for our dog. Highly recommended by us!
Absolutely amazing experience from start to finish. Our dog was pampered and loved. It’s a huge relief to find a place where he feels so comfortable.

Our experience was truly top-notch and we couldn't be happier. Our pup returned home looking refreshed and joyful, clearly having benefited from the attentive care and the deep affection provided by the staff. We will definitely be returning soon!
This is the best place for dog boarding and dog daycare in Montreal!

Great experience! They only cared for one dog at a time, which I really appreciated. My dog is a bit reactive so I was worried, but they handled everything so well and made me feel at ease. Would definitely recommend!
Priya is an amazing dog sitter and dog walker. She has great communication and is flexible with our last-minute requests.
Very professional and reliable. Photos are provided after each outing.

Rohit was an awesome dog sitter! He was very welcoming when we arrived and took great care of our three dogs. The dogs seemed very happy and we enjoyed the updates throughout their stay. Nothing better than a home away from home for your fur babies!

We’re so grateful to Rohit for the amazing care he’s given our dog, Guinness. Since our recent move to Montreal, Guinness has been dealing with separation anxiety, so leaving him hasn’t been easy for us. Rohit sends lots of pictures an updates throughout the day to make us feel at ease :)

Rohit has watched him twice now, and we’ve already noticed Guinness is starting to warm up to him! It’s clear that Rohit is patient, attentive, and genuinely cares about the dogs he looks after.

Thank you, Rohit, for taking such great care of our boy and helping make this transition a little easier for us. We truly appreciate it!

Highly recommend! Needed an urgent, last-minute dog boarding because my regular sitter cancelled. Thanks to our new sitter Amy's flexibility we were quickly able to do a meet & greet and the long weekend stay at her place. Got lots of photos and videos throughout the weekend and my dog was very happy. Great first-time experience.

Supporting our fellow dog loving partner business against bullies. We highly recommend Montreal Dog Club for dog daycare, dog sitting and dog walking. We always recommend clients to each other because we care about our shared community, unlike some greedy businesses ruining the vibes. Sending pawsitive energy! 🐶 🫶🏾 …

Here to support Montreal Dog Club and their lovely people against scammers who are leaving fake negative 1 star reviews against them. They took care of my dog when my wife was hospitalized. Walked my dog in -20°C. Walked her during a snowstorm. Always responsive and flexible with timing. Last-minute emergencies. They handle everything with professionalism and love.
Genuinely nice people running this business. Happy to support local, hard working pet sitters. True dog lovers who care for their community. Sad to see trolls messing with them.

We are very pleased with Jordan counselling.
In a short period we have already seen a nice change in our Welsh Terrier. Walks will be an improvement going forward, Jordan is very professional, knowledgeable and service minded. We highly recommend
Andree and Gerry Hughes
My dog was very happy! Rohit was always keeping me updated everyday. I'm so glad I found him! I will always book with Montreal Dog Club.
He took great care of my dog I was soooo worried and he made it simple and my dog had the best time
Rohit was very friendly. Thank you!

Wonderful experience with Montreal Dog Club. We visited Montreal for the weekend and our pup was walked and given nighttime scratches, and we had regular updates. Rohit was very patient with me getting lost in Montreal so we were late for pickup! Thanks so much for the great experience.
Rohit was responsive and easy to work with. Our dog immediately warmed up to him and had two very nice half day visits! Definitely recommend and will use services again.
First time and I really felt my dog was well taken care of. Thank you very much Rohit!

Rohit was AMAZING with our pup, Jasper!!! Jasper is a bit shy and cautious of new people, and Rohit was kind and patient with him. They became besties in no time! We got photo updates periodically and he was having a blast. Lots of fun, but not overstimulating for a little guy like ours. Rohit really has set the bar high for care for our pup, and we look forward to seeing him again soon :)

I was looking for last minute dog sitting for the day as I had some plans that were unable to accommodate dogs. Rohit was a life saver, super flexible and responsive and was sending me pictures and videos of my doggie hanging out. I felt at ease since I saw great reviews already and the constant communication as well as Rohit had a good vibe around him when we met him. Would HIGHLY recommend!
Rohit too great care of our little Léo. He was calm and kind with our 1 year old Maltese who had never been away from home. He came home happy and we appreciate knowing he was in capable hands!

Booked a stay for my dog months in advance, but Rohit waited until 48 hours before my departure to disclose a 78.6% price increase (from $42/day to $75/day). As a repeat client with a long history at the established $42 rate, I was never given any notice of a change until my bags were packed.

When I called out the lack of transparency, the response was a ‘take it or leave it’ ultimatum to cancel.

Holding a client’s travel plans hostage to force a massive price hike is predatory and illegal.

My puppy spends his Wednesdays with Rohit and we are so happy with the service provided! Simba is a sensitive, nervous puppy and Rohit is so calm and patient with him. Simba is getting more comfortable every week. We get lots of WhatsApp updates, and feel confident that he’s getting great care while we’re away. Thanks Rohit!
I recommend Rohit for taking care of your dog, our dog spent the whole day with him and she seemed to like it. Also we were getting pics for updates
My little dog is in Rohit's good care several days a week; he's incredibly happy, and I'm at peace! I highly recommend him! Thank you, Rohit!

My dog Cooper has been a bit of a challenge for other sitters before so I was a little nervous but Rohit was great! He has a very calming presence which helped a lot, and he sent me plenty of photos and took great care of my special boy. Cooper came back calm and happy. I've very grateful that I found someone I trust to take care of him and I would recommend Montreal Dog Club to anyone!
Rohit did an excellent job in taking care of my dog - he consistently shares photos/videos, and reports the status, occasionally asking important questions. Overall, recommend this place 100%

Very very happy with Griffintown Dog Boarding.

I received daily updates about Quincy and Chyna while I was out of town for about a week. They were well cared for and happy to be with Rohit.

They got frequent walks and much affection.  Everything I could ask for in a dog sitter.

Will definitely call Rohit on my next trip. 💕💕

We are grateful to have found Rohit to take care of our dog. She gets anxious when we are away, but we noticed that when we picked her up she was surprisingly calmed. That was really nice to see, she was so comfortable. Thank you Rohit!

such an amazing experience, Rohit is incredibly competent, attentive and very easy to work with. He is kind professional and genuinely cares about my dog
If you are looking for a personalized pet boarding place, this is the place to go 🫶🏼 …
Rohit was great with my dog and easy to work with!
Rohit is very calm and patient with my super high energy dog! He also allowed for flexible drop off and pick up times which was very appreciated. Thanks, Rohit!

Rohit was absolutely amazing! Our dog Milo has never been boarded before and is very shy. Rohit was very calm and reassuring and Milo felt right at home. Absolutely would leave him with Rohit again when visiting Montreal. Thanks again Rohit !
I had an amazing experience with Griffintown dog boarding! It was very well organized and I felt more than safe sending my puppy over for day boarding :)

Griffintown Dog Boarding was a lifesaver during my trip to Montreal. My inquiry was responded to within minutes. Communication, booking and payment was seamless. Rohit was so attentive and caring. Pictures and updates were sent often. Best of all, my boy felt right at home. Can’t thank you all enough! Definitely will book again when I’m in town.
Rohit is awesome and very reliable! I gave him instructions and everything was done perfectly and more!

Rohit took excellent care of our dog Buddy. He has a great understanding of dogs and their owners.
We got updates from the first few minutes of leaving our pet with Rohit, to daily pictures and videos during Buddy's stay.
My dog was happy and at ease.
100% recommended.

I had a wonderful experience with Griffintown Dog Boarding. Every step in the booking process was smooth. I had a meet & greet with our pet sitter so my dogs could explore their apartment.

Throughout the whole process, communication was excellent. I got plenty of pictures and videos everyday which gave me total peace of mind. My dogs got a better vacation with Rohit than I did in Italy!

Rohit is an amazing dog sitter. He keeps us posted throughout the day by sending photos and videos of our dog. You can see he loves them and takes good care of them. We definitely recommend his service!
We've been using their private dog walking service for several months. Rohit is always professional, punctual and most importantly our dogs love him. We appreciate the photo and video updates.

Replied once to send an email asking me to fill out a new client form, then ghosted me, despite me following up twice more to attempt to organise daycare.
It’s fine if the services I needed for my dog doesn’t work for you, but communication is key.
My dog Luke is always happy to see his favourite dog-sitter Rohit. He has a flexible schedule that makes pick-up and drop off easy. He is also great for accommodating Luke’s special needs.
Rohit is great! Has such an amazing calm energy that put my dog at ease from the moment they met. Highly recommend!

I’m so glad to have met Rohit. His services provided safe care for my pup, in a little bit of a last minute booking. Wouldn’t hesitate to call on him again.
Thanks!!

Griffintown Dog Boarding was fantastic. Rohit took both our cat and dog in for the weekend and they loved it so much, they didn’t want to leave. We would get photos of them a couple times a day. They always looked so happy. We will definitely be using Griffintown Dog Boarding in the future!
Great experience having them look after our pup while we were here for the day! Lots of pics and updates throughout the day too which is always appreciated. Easy drop off and pickup.
Rohit was great with my good boy Kona!! He was very professional and sent me multiple updates during the days. Kona looked relaxed and comfortable during his stay. Highly recommended!!

Highly recommend Rohit for any dog care needs!  My pup has been with him for both daycare and boarding.  Rohit provides great care, regular updates with photos and, most importantly, my pup is always excited to spend time with him.

Highly recommended!
I left my dog in his care for two days. He is very good with dogs and kept me updated with messages and photos. It was clear my dog was comfortable and well taken care of.

We had our puppy boarded twice already with Rohit and he is absolutely amazing with her! It’s like a second home when she goes there. She is super happy and well taken care of. We got multiple updates and pics/videos that  reassured us that she was loved and in good hands. I recommend Rohit without hesitation! Will send our baby there again without a doubt!

Rosie loves to stay with Rohit where she is cared for lovingly and with the utmost professionalism. And she has great fun! Rohit is the best! Rohit’s home is also Rosie’s. She arrives so excited to spend time with her friend Rohit. And we leave feeling so lucky to have Rohit in our lives. We receive photos and videos daily, often a few times each day. We have only the highest recommendation for anyone needing a home away from home for their dogs.

Our dog Charlie had an awesome time with Rohit. We felt very comfortable having Charlie stay with Rohit while we were traveling. Rohit kept us updated daily and sent us pics on their fun times. Will definitely have Rohit dog sit for us again. Highly recommend.

I can’t recommend Rohit enough! He took amazing care of my dog while I was away. From the daily updates and adorable photos to their clear love and understanding of dogs, I felt totally at ease knowing my pup was in good hands. My dog came back happy, well-exercised, and clearly well-loved. I’ll definitely be booking again!
